prompt:
You describe a photo or rendering from an electronics datasheet for an engineer who cannot see it.

Cover, in this order:
1. What object is shown and from which side.
2. Every visible marking: labels, part numbers, logos, connectors, pin markings.
3. Dimensions or scale, if shown.

Figure type: photo or rendering
Section: 7 PCB Design Guidelines > 7.5 BHI3xy placement rules for the top layer
Caption: Figure 20: Top layer placement examples for BHI3xy
Text inside the figure (read from this image by a specialised OCR model; use these spellings): hole size | via-through layer thickness | RIGHT: Place blind vias within central pads for signal routing | RIGHT: Drilling aspect ratio of 1:1 or greater | WRONG: Via under the sensor except for the central pads
Text that mentions the figure: BHI3xy is pin-to-pin compatible with BMI2xy and BMI3xy for outer pads. In addition, BHI3xy has six inner pads.

Rules:
- When a name or number from "Text inside the figure" is visible in the image, copy it exactly, character for character.
- Never invent a value, name, pin, unit or connection. If something is too small or blurry to read, write "unreadable" instead of guessing.
- Describe only what this image shows. Do not explain general theory or add advice.
- Mention each item once. Stop when everything is covered.
- Plain text only: no Markdown headings, tables or bold. Short paragraphs and "- " lists are fine.
- Start directly with what the figure is (for example "Block diagram of ..."), not with "The image shows".

answer.text:
Rendering of three PCB layout examples for the top layer.

Left image: A close-up view of a red PCB surface showing traces and pads. Visible markings include "S2" and "S3". The caption below reads: "RIGHT: Place blind vias within central pads for signal routing".

Center image: A 3D rendering of a cylindrical component mounted on a green PCB. Visible labels include "hole size" with horizontal dimension lines, "via-through layer thickness" with a vertical dimension line, and the caption below reads: "RIGHT: Drilling aspect ratio of 1:1 or greater".

Right image: A close-up view of a red PCB surface showing traces and pads. Visible markings include "S2" and "S3". A yellow dotted line highlights a via placement. The caption below reads: "WRONG: Via under the sensor except for the central pads".

The figure is titled "Figure 20: Top layer placement examples for BHI3xy" and is from Section 7 PCB Design Guidelines > 7.5 BHI3xy placement rules for the top layer. The accompanying text mentions that BHI3xy is pin-to-pin compatible with BMI2xy and BMI3xy for outer pads, and BHI3xy has six inner pads.
